result.summary: Found several visual issues: a broken/missing restaurant image placeholder, truncated restaurant names, and a partially visible category chip that appears cut off beyond normal carousel behavior.

issues.description: The 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card under 'Popular right now' shows a large empty gray area with only a generic image-broken icon placeholder instead of a food photo.
issues.suggestion: Load the correct restaurant/cover image for this listing, or show a proper fallback illustration and ensure image URLs are valid.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated/cut off on the right in the 'Fastest near you' row.
issues.suggestion: Allow the name to wrap to two lines, use a shorter display name, or ensure card width accommodates typical restaurant name lengths with ellipsis only when necessary.

issues.description: The category filter chips row ends with a partially visible empty/white pill on the far right, which looks like a broken or incomplete chip rather than a normal peek of the next category label.
issues.suggestion: Ensure each chip has proper content and padding, and that horizontal scroll peeks show a recognizable portion of the next labeled category.
